stem.text: An experiment was carried out to investigate the effect of concentration of sucrose solution on cells in a plant tissue.
A sample of plant tissue was cut into seven cylinders of equal length and diameter. The mass of each cylinder was recorded.
Each of the seven cylinders was put into a different sucrose solution concentration.

stem.alt: Test-tube with a bung, containing sucrose solution and a plant tissue cylinder, with labels bung, sucrose solution, test-tube and plant tissue cylinder

stem.text: After two hours, the cylinders were removed, blotted dry and reweighed. The percentage change in mass of each cylinder was recorded.
The graph shows the results of this investigation.

stem.alt: Graph of percentage change in mass of plant tissue cylinder against concentration of sucrose solution in mol dm−3, with seven data points joined by straight lines, axes labelled from −20 to 20 and from 0 to 0.7

stem.text: Which row explains the results if plant tissue cells were put in a sucrose solution of $0.45\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$?
